author: Cytokinesis
body:
This is my first map, Prime, that I did with a friend.
 The teams are cyan versus lime and it's 20v20. Each player spawns with
  • Dyed leather armour
  • Stone sword
  • Infinity bow
  • Diamond pick axe
  • 32 oak logs
  • 64 stone blocks
  • 3 golden apples
  • 8 steak(16 chicken for thanksgivng)
  • 1 arrow
Yaml: http://pastie.org/private/nnzdctshet86k5oikkkuua
Album: http://imgur.com/aq28mc4,F5jLCd1,g8yPwS2,sAsl3Gg,C66eEQr
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/231hfh8yqiiyi4v/SilverWolf.rar

Thanks to Alexanderjoe for letting me use his build server and to para for doing the yaml.
